scenes.title: Introduction
lines: Hi friends! I'm the Ultrasonic Sensor.
Call me H C S R zero four.
These look like eyes, but one is my mouth, and one is my ear!

scenes.title: How I Work
lines: I send out sound too high for you to hear.
It hits an object and bounces back as an echo.
I time the echo to find the distance.
Bats do the very same thing!

scenes.title: The Formula
lines: Distance equals speed of sound, times time, divided by two.
Divided by two, because the sound goes there and back!

scenes.title: My Specs
lines: I measure from two centimetres to four metres.
I run on just five volts.
My pins are V C C, Trig, Echo and Ground. Arduino is my best friend!

scenes.title: Where I Work
lines: I help cars park safely.
I guide robots around walls.
I check water in tanks.
I warn blind people about obstacles.
And I open smart dustbins!

scenes.title: Finale
lines: I'm small, but my job is big!
Use me in your next science project!
Ultrasonic Sensor. The smart friend that measures distance!
